findings.title: Endpoint CSV/JSON exports lose access and auto-poll configuration
findings.mechanism: FleetEndpoint descriptor rows have no access/auto properties. These columns read separate maps in their renderers, but provide no exportValue. DataTable export reads row[column.key] and extractRenderedText(renderer); a Toggle element has no children, so both fields serialize as null (blank CSV). Nonpollable dash does not recover actual configuration. Local exports are enabled by default for this unpaginated table.
findings.sourceRepro: Use a synthetic existing descriptor with access=true and auto=true, or access=false and auto=false. Follow DataTable.handleExport for visible access/auto columns: undefined row properties plus childless Toggle become null in JSON and blank CSV regardless of the displayed switch state. Download was NOTRUN.
findings.expected: Export current known access/effective auto booleans, keeping unknown/not-scheduled distinct from false.
findings.narrowFixNeed: Existing FleetEndpointTable owner adds explicit exportValue callbacks for access/auto and focused export regression cases; consider preserving raw operation identity through exportValue at :29-32. Do not create another table/export system.
findings.history: Previously recorded in audit-page-013 architectureIssues; current source mechanism remains present. This report does not redispatch or repair the accepted page.

findings.title: Category region accessible name bypasses localization
findings.mechanism: Visible headings/navigation call groupLabel(group), which translates category labels. The named section uses raw backend group text as aria-label. A translated category therefore leaves its region name in backend English. HTTP-method identity labels are not the problem.
findings.sourceRepro: In category mode, resolve fleetApi.categories.vehicledata to a non-English translated label. Heading/nav use that result; the section's aria-label remains Vehicle data because it receives group, not groupLabel(group). Locale switching and screen-reader execution were NOTRUN.
findings.expected: Region accessible name agrees with the localized visible heading while raw group/table identities remain stable.
findings.narrowFixNeed: FleetAPIRouteCatalog owner uses groupLabel(group) for the name or associates the localized heading through a stable ID; add a focused translated-label regression.
findings.history: Same bounded source finding exists in audit-page-013; no new locale campaign is authorized.
